text:
maria: Heads up — PhoenixLine (trial) is seeing 95th tail jumps during our onboarding load test, from ~0.9s to ~2.4s on chat completions. I did a quick trace: long prefixes + KV cache misses look correlated. Proactive idea: run a small canary with an int8 quantized model + split routing (short vs long seqs). Want to propose a low-risk rollout plan and get ops/SE alignment.

raj: Sounds reasonable. Which model are you thinking? switching to a 13B int8 (redwood/llama-13b-compat-int8) could cut token cost ~40–50% and reduce p99 processing time. We should validate on a small gold prompt set (10–15) to confirm quality doesn't regress. Also suggest enabling prefix KV cache and routing short requests to the quant variant while long contexts hit the fp16 variant.

lucy: I can book an enablement call with PhoenixLine SRE/Product — tomorrow 10am PT works? I'll add the prompt set and initial eval dashboard to the invite.

dylan: Note from infra: ops-bot flagged memory pressure on their Dedicated pool last week during a spike. If we route more long sequences to fp16 we'll need to watch GPU memory and potentially enable burst capacity for the first 24–48h.

maria: Proposed rollout (short note):
1) Run offline eval: 10 gold prompts + business-critical prompts on llama-13b-int8 vs current baseline (fp16). Capture quality metrics (accuracy/intent match, hallucination checks, customer-specific metrics).
2) Canary: 5% traffic for 24h with metrics guards (95th_latency, error_rate, quality_score).
3) If quality delta > 2% on key metrics OR hallucination rate increases, auto rollback. Otherwise ramp to 25% after 24h.
4) Enable KV cache pre-warm for known prefixes and monitor KV_cache_hit_rate.

maria: @raj can you spin up the eval script + baseline numbers? add any tuning knobs (temp/top_p) that help compensate for int8 subtlety.

raj: On it — I'll run the eval and post a short table by EOD. Quick tip: int8 often looks fine but may need a slight temp or top_p tweak to match response diversity; I'll include suggested knobs.

lucy: Call invite sent to phoenixline-eng and CS. Captured CS ask: keep 95th latency <1.2s and limit service-impacting incidents to <0.5% in the first two weeks post-change. I'll capture any feature/use-case-specific golden prompts on the call.

maria: ops-bot run preflight for canary config: /deploy-checklist new-canary phoenixline model=llama-13b-int8 percent=5 duration=24h metrics=[95th_latency,error_rate,quality_score]

ops-bot: preflight OK — quota and capacity available. Monitoring hooks provisioned. Alerts configured for thresholds. Note: watch KV_cache_hit_rate and route_fallbacks.

maria: Great — I'll draft the canary doc (steps + rollback criteria + who-to-escalate) and paste it here before the call. Any other concerns?

dylan: Please include a quick post-canary verification checklist for memory and GPU utilization per node.

maria: Will do. Thanks team — will follow up with eval results and the canary doc in this thread.
